_comment: Per-field value guide (generated by scripts/build_value_guide.py from schema.json). Tells a filler what each field should contain, with formats, address components, calculations to validate, and adversarial values to avoid. Not legal advice.

decedent_name.label: Decedent Name
decedent_name.expects: free text answering the printed prompt

affiant_name.label: Affiant Name
affiant_name.expects: free text answering the printed prompt

affiant_address.label: Affiant Address
affiant_address.expects: an address with: street, city, state, zip
avoid: the state spelled out ('Maine') when an abbreviation fits
a PO box where a physical/legal residence is required

decedent_town.label: Decedent Town
decedent_town.expects: free text answering the printed prompt

decedent_county.label: Decedent County
decedent_county.expects: a Maine county name (the form prints 'COUNTY'/'Probate Court'); rendered upper-case, without the word 'County'

date_of_death.label: Date Of Death
date_of_death.expects: free text answering the printed prompt

year_of_death.label: Year Of Death
avoid: text spanning the printed '20' stub — fill only the remaining digits if the form prints '20__'

affidavit_date.label: Affidavit Date
avoid: a value that runs across a printed comma or '20__' stub — those are separate day/month/year fields

notary_county.label: Notary County
notary_county.expects: a Maine county name (the form prints 'COUNTY'/'Probate Court'); rendered upper-case, without the word 'County'

notarization_day.label: Notarization Day
avoid: a value that runs across a printed comma or '20__' stub — those are separate day/month/year fields

notarization_month.label: Notarization Month
avoid: a value that runs across a printed comma or '20__' stub — those are separate day/month/year fields

notarization_year_suffix.label: Notarization Year Suffix
avoid: a value that runs across a printed comma or '20__' stub — those are separate day/month/year fields
